title: How I work: bottom-up.
intro: When I get a task, I work from the ground up: clarify the requirement, inspect the available data, make the system behavior explicit, implement, verify, and document the decisions.

stages.label: 01 Clarify
stages.title: Align on requirements
stages.summary: I restate the task, clarify open questions, and confirm what done should look like before implementation starts.
details: I restate the requirement in plain language.
I flag what I do not understand yet.
I confirm the expected outcome before moving ahead.
stages.aiRole: AI can summarize notes or draft a checklist.
stages.myRole: I own the clarification and alignment.

stages.label: 02 Connect
stages.title: Inspect the inputs
stages.summary: I review the available data, identify useful relationships, and decide what needs to drive the implementation.
details: I inspect what information already exists.
I look for relationships and gaps.
I use AI here if it helps me compare, summarize, or structure faster.
stages.aiRole: AI can help summarize, compare, and organize options.
stages.myRole: I decide what is actually useful for the task.

stages.label: 03 Build
stages.title: Implement the solution
stages.summary: I gather missing context, choose the right structure, and build the requested behavior in a way that stays reviewable.
details: I gather missing context before committing to a direction.
I build around the real requirement.
stages.aiRole: AI can speed up drafts, debugging, refactors, and alternatives.
stages.myRole: I own the implementation choices and quality.

stages.label: 04 Test
stages.title: Test, debug, fix
stages.summary: I manually test edge cases, invalid inputs, missing states, permission gaps, and user-stuck points. When issues show up, I debug, fix, and retest.
details: I test edge cases and bad data paths.
I check permission and state gaps.
I debug and retest after fixes.
stages.aiRole: AI can suggest test cases and risky branches.
stages.myRole: I verify, debug, fix, and retest before shipping.

stages.label: 05 Document
stages.title: Document the handoff
stages.summary: After the build works, I document what changed, why it works that way, and anything the next person should not have to rediscover.
details: I write down key decisions and assumptions.
I explain setup, behavior, and edge cases where needed.
I keep the handoff clear enough to use later.
stages.aiRole: AI can help turn notes into cleaner documentation.
stages.myRole: I make sure the documentation is accurate and useful.
